li_projects.title: HotSpots.ai
li_projects.description: HotSpots.ai is a city scale geospatial analytics platform that uses real time satellite and urban data to map urban heat vulnerability and inform climate resilience strategies.

posts.text: Recently I took part in Hack the 6ix 🚀 Vrunda Shah, Jay Patel and I built Bopple, an AI coding agent you control entirely from Telegram. You text it a task, it clones your repo into an isolated cloud VM, runs an agent loop to write and test the code, commits, and opens a real PR. You get pinged with the link when it's ready to review.
